# uptimekuma_notification_discord (Resource)

Discord notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_discord" "example" {
  name        = "Discord Notifications"
  webhook_url = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123456789/abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
  username    = "Uptime Kuma"
  is_default  = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_discord" "alerts_channel" {
  name           = "Discord Critical Alerts"
  webhook_url    = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/987654321/zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba"
  username       = "Uptime Kuma Alerts"
  prefix_message = "🚨 ALERT"
  disable_url    = false
  is_default     = true
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: webhook_url_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change webhook_url_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_discord" "write_only" {
  name = "Discord with a write-only secret"

  webhook_url_wo         = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123/your-token"
  webhook_url_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `channel_type` (String) The type of Discord channel associated with the webhook (for example, text, forum, or announcement).
- `disable_url` (Boolean) If true, disables including the monitor URL in the Discord notification.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `post_name` (String) The display name override for the Discord webhook when posting notifications (appears as the sender name in Discord).
- `prefix_message` (String) A message to prefix to all Discord notifications.
- `thread_id` (String) The ID of the Discord thread to send the notification to, if applicable.
- `username` (String) The username to display as the sender of the Discord notification.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) The Discord webhook URL to which notifications will be sent. Stored in state; use `webhook_url_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `webhook_url_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The Discord webhook URL to which notifications will be sent, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `webhook_url`; requires `webhook_url_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `webhook_url_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `webhook_url` until the next apply with `webhook_url_wo` set removes it from state.
- `webhook_url_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `webhook_url_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `webhook_url_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
